idea-plugin.name: Technical Debt Accountant
idea-plugin.description:
Technical Debt Accountant — Quantify Code Debt in Dollars

Speak management's language. Technical Debt Accountant transforms abstract code quality issues into dollar amounts with ROI calculations, interest rate tracking, and burndown charts that make the business case for refactoring impossible to ignore.

Debt Health Score

  • A–F Health Grade — A 0–100 score with a letter grade summarizing your codebase's debt pressure at a glance, in the tool window, reports, and a clickable status bar widget
  • Status Bar Widget — Always-on Debt <grade> · <monthly interest>/mo indicator with a detailed tooltip; click to jump to the Tech Debt tool window
  • Monthly Debt Budget — Set a budget and get flagged when recurring interest exceeds it

Debt Tracking

  • Debt Inventory — Catalog items with 9 categories, 4 priority levels, and estimated fix times
  • Add Debt at Cursor — Press Alt+D to log a debt item at the current file and line
  • Workaround Logging — Log minutes spent working around a debt item, with an optional note

Analysis and Detection

  • TODO/FIXME Scanner — Imports TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX/OPTIMIZE comments as debt items with marker-based category and priority; deduplicates on re-scan
  • Hotspot Detection — Identifies files with the highest debt concentration by weighted score
  • Project Persistence — Data stored in .tech-debt/inventory.json for Git tracking

Financial Modeling

  • Dollar Valuation — Converts workaround time to costs using configurable hourly rates
  • Monthly Interest — Tracks recurring workaround costs over 30-day windows
  • ROI Calculator — Calculates breakeven months and prioritizes by return on investment
  • Trend Forecast — Projects debt count, dollars and an estimated burndown date from weekly digest snapshots
  • Management Reports — Executive-ready Markdown reports with summaries and ROI opportunities
  • CSV/JSON Export — Share the backlog with management in Excel/Sheets, with computed dollar costs

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ (build 251+)

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/technical-debt-accountant

2026.7.0

  • Debt Health Score - A 0–100 score with an A–F letter grade summarizing your codebase's debt pressure, shown in the Tech Debt tool window, management reports, and a new status bar widget
  • Status Bar Widget - Always-on Debt grade + monthly-interest indicator with a detailed tooltip; click to open the Tech Debt tool window
  • Monthly Debt Budget - New setting flags the project as over budget when recurring interest exceeds the configured threshold
  • Stability - The debt inventory store is now fully thread-safe, removing a ConcurrentModificationException risk when background scans run while the UI reads the inventory
  • Polish - Refreshed plugin icon (light + dark)

2026.6.0

  • TODO/FIXME Comment Scanner - Tools → Scan TODO/FIXME Comments… imports TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX/OPTIMIZE comments as debt items with marker-based category and priority; re-scans deduplicate automatically. A CLI entry point with --fail-over supports CI gates
  • CSV/JSON Inventory Export - Tools → Export Debt Inventory… exports the backlog with computed workaround and fix costs for Excel/Sheets or downstream tooling
  • Input Validation - The Add Debt Item dialog now validates description, line range, and fix estimate before saving
  • Stability - Tool window updates triggered from background tasks (scan import, SLA escalation) are now dispatched on the UI thread; inventory listeners are thread-safe
